title: V1: Web — production account service and staging deploy after the owner's local test
body: Owner tests the full local stack first (scripts/dev/full-local.sh, docs/dev/full-local.md). Then: stand up the production account service (gateway accounts block, GitHub OAuth secret, keyring secret), deploy openagents-web to staging with the prod chat bucket settings corrected (not the staging bucket), check, then production on the owner's go.
